identificationRemarks: The difference between ocellaris and percula is often best determined by geography. Anything east of Cenderawasih Bay will always be percula, and anything west is currently treated as A. ocellaris. It's possibly the two overlap and hybridize in areas like Halmahera or Lembeh, making identifications from that region tentative at best. Note that specimens from the Indian Ocean are genetically distinct from the Indo-Philippines ocellaris (which are best considered as an undescribed species).
